name: Pyromancer: Cataclysm leaps, damages and dazes natively (#1946)
contract: #1946: Cataclysm 520218 is an active spell that works through stock effects: E2 LEAP_BACK (SpellEffects.cpp:5391), E3 triggers Knockback 520220 (Fire school damage 10+2/level plus KNOCK_BACK, triggering Slow 520868) and E1 a periodic trigger at 2299 ms casting Charge Back Down 520219 (damage, knockback). The 520868 daze is scripted into Dazed 1604 lasting 6000 ms (AscensionPyromancerAbilities.cpp:371-380). Asserts that casting it damages the adjacent target, applies Dazed with a 6 s duration, and that the caster casts 520219 once after the leap. Not verified in game by the audit: a failure points at a stock handler or the DBC set.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle

Charge Back Down lands 2.3 s later
